verdict.rationale: The evidence covers questionnaires Sprinto sends to vendors and AI-assisted review of vendor due diligence. That is outbound vendor-risk assessment, which is adjacent to but different from AI drafting answers to inbound customer questionnaires from your own controls and knowledge base. Nothing in the pack documents AI-generated answer drafts for a sales team to review, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
